title: Choose Your Research Story: From Article to Talk
objective: Students learn to turn a paper into a simple presentation story.
outcomes: Identify the research problem and why it matters.
Choose 3-4 key points for a short talk.
Avoid copying the article structure too heavily.
activity: Research story card: students fill four boxes: problem, method, main result, why it matters.
example: A paper about enzyme activity can become a story: why enzyme speed matters, what temperature was tested, what result was found, and why it matters.
